podcast.title: The Weeknd Signing
podcast.body: Capitol Music Group successfully signed The Weeknd after Nate Albert, an A&R executive, fended off more than two dozen other competing offers. This highlights the competitive nature of securing top talent. "Capital Music Group."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Universal Music Group Division and Imprints
podcast.body: Capitol Music Group functions as a major division within the Universal Music Group structure. This division encompasses several well-known imprints, including Capitol Records, Virgin Records of America, Astral Works, Caroline, and Motown, alongside many others. "If we look at, say, just a capital music group, that division includes capital records, Virgin Records of America, Astral Works, Caroline, Motown, and literally dozens of others."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
